comment: Real baseline (PROJECT.md 11.5): server app.kb.retrieval.retrieve run read-only against Neon with NIM query embeddings, 2026-10-14. Supersedes the hash-embedding local proxy (kept below, labelled non-representative). CI fails on regressions of more than 5 percentage points vs retrieval. Test set is LLM-drafted and unreviewed; re-baseline after human review. Note: vector_ranked has no ORDER BY, so reruns may vary slightly on near-tied scores.

retrieval_hash_proxy_superseded.comment: Non-representative: deterministic hash vectors carry no semantics; kept for history only.
